intro: Your mother asks what you want to be when you grow up. Explain your dream.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: You are growing up so fast. What do you want to be one day?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you want to become.
expected: I want to become a doctor.
When I grow up I want to be a teacher.
I would like to become an engineer.
conversation.hint: Try: "I want to become a doctor."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: That is a wonderful dream. Why that one?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: Because I want to help sick people.
Because I am good at science.
conversation.hint: Try: "Because I want to help sick people."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: And what must you do to reach that dream?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you will have to do.
expected: I will have to study hard.
I must study science every day.
I will work hard at school.
conversation.hint: Try: "I will have to study hard."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: That is true. Which subject will help you most?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Name the subject and say why it helps.
expected: Maths will help me the most.
English, because I must talk to people.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: I am proud of you. I know you will do well.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Thank your mother and say you will try.
expected: Thank you, Mummy. I will try my best.
Thank you. I hope I can do it.
Thank you for believing in me.
conversation.hint: Try: "Thank you, Mummy. I will try my best."
